mapper.select: SELECT po.option_id AS optionId, pov.option_value_id AS optionValueId, po.product_id AS productId, po.option_name AS optionName, pov.option_value AS optionValue, pov.status AS status FROM product_option po JOIN product_option_value pov ON pov.option_id = po.option_id WHERE po.product_id = #{productId} AND pov.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY po.option_name, pov.sort_order, pov.option_value

SELECT po.option_id AS optionId, pov.option_value_id AS optionValueId, po.product_id AS productId, po.option_name AS optionName, pov.option_value AS optionValue, pov.status AS status FROM product_option po JOIN product_option_value pov ON pov.option_id = po.option_id WHERE po.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY po.option_name, pov.sort_order, pov.option_value
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_option(option_id, product_id, category_id, option_name) VALUES (#{optionId}, #{productId}, #{categoryId}, #{optionName})

INSERT IGNORE INTO product_option_value(option_value_id, option_id, option_value, sort_order) VALUES ( #{optionValueId}, #{optionId}, #{optionValue}, CASE WHEN #{sortOrder} IS NULL OR #{sortOrder} = 0 THEN (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(t.sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM product_option_value t WHERE t.option_id = #{optionId}) ELSE #{sortOrder} END )
